d: An avian humanoid with a mature, poised expression and a slender, elegant build. The head features a sharp beak and a dramatic crest of flowing, flame-orange and deep crimson feathers that sweep backward. The body is adorned in a long, form-fitting gown of deep teal and obsidian black with red accents, blending seamlessly into a massive, sweeping train of dark iridescent feathers. Large, expansive wings in shades of midnight blue and teal emerge from the back, while a singular, long, trailing plume of red and teal feathers extends from the waist. BODY COLOR: Deep teal and obsidian LEGS: Digitigrade, ending in avian talons.
